reasoning: 驗證目標：在 ON AIR 類別選取演出者、歌曲名稱或頻道時，調諧至對應頻道。為什麼這樣切：條款以 or 並列三種可選取的項目，三者皆須導致調諧，故程序各測一次；前置條件令對應頻道非現行頻道，否則無變化亦通過。與 124 的差別：該 leaf 驗清單內容，本 leaf 驗選取後的調諧（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Selecting an artist, song or channel on ON AIR tunes to it
tcs.test_item: The HU shall tune to the corresponding channel when an artist, song title or channel is selected on the ON AIR category
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three stored favorites are being broadcast on three channels other than the currently tuned channel, one stored as an artist and one stored as a song title
5. The Favorites ON AIR list is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the entry stored as an artist and read the tuned channel
2. Return to the ON AIR list, select the entry stored as a song title and read the tuned channel
3. Return to the ON AIR list, select the third entry by its channel and read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned channel is the channel shown for the selected artist
2. The tuned channel is the channel shown for the selected song title
3. The tuned channel is the channel selected
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
